arrangement: Two equal views sit side by side, separated by a narrow white gutter.

regions.depiction: A round blue courier robot reaches toward a parcel on a waist-high shelf.

subjects.depiction: The blue robot stands beside the shelf with both grippers open around the parcel.

regions.depiction: The same blue robot carries the parcel away from the shelf, held close to its chest.

subjects.depiction: The robot steps forward with both grippers supporting the parcel.
subjects.pose_and_body_geometry: Elbows bent and one foot lifted into a step.
subjects.props_and_contacts: Both grippers support the parcel from below.

relationships.relation: Successive moments in the same collection action: the robot first reaches for the parcel, then carries it.
